items.title: Ernie Cagnolatti Interview, 1961-04-05
items.q: And it turned out to be one of the best drummers, modern drum players in the city called Oral Palmer.

ctx.x: Just to show you how, at that time, they had a young kid that was learning how to play the drums. And he wasn't quite in the union. Harold took money out of his pocket and paid to put him in the union to play that job with him. And it turned out to be one of the best drummers, modern drum players in the city called Oral Palmer. Working in Hollywood right now, behind them scenes, in them theaters. Yeah, he's writing all the rhymes.
He's great. He wanted the greatest.
